circuit.note: identical to the MCP safety envelope: two consecutive timeout/network failures in one planner turn open the circuit per (server, capability, turn); expired cooldown allows one half-open probe

criticality.note: optional plus JEV_UNAVAILABLE yields structured deterministic fallback and never blocks the task

credential_source.name: JEV_API_KEY
credential_source.note: name of the user-owned environment variable only; never a credential value; the real transport reads this variable inside the envelope probe runspace

transport.note: env variable NAMES only, never values: JEV_BASE_URL is required and must be an absolute https URL, or an absolute http URL ONLY on a loopback host (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1]) so the Bearer key is never sent in clear to a remote host; JEV_MODEL is optional; there is no key-prefix routing (the kernel requires an explicit base URL), redirects are never followed and absent or invalid configuration yields a structured JEV_TRANSPORT_NOT_CONFIGURED that never blocks the task

authority.note: jev output is advisory evidence only; kernel, verifier, reviewer and security always win
